messages:
maria: Quick sync — need to decide how inspect-mode & metrics collection interact with PII redaction and consent. Ops wants ability to view raw request/response for oncall debugging. Legal needs explicit consent records + audit trail. Can we design a minimal flow that satisfies both?

kevin_p: +1. My proposal: default telemetry is scrubbed. Add an ephemeral 'inspect session' that unlocks raw traces for a time-limited window. Access requires a request (ticket) + approval, and generates an immutable audit event. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

samg: Sounds reasonable. Constraints to call out: 1) retention for raw = hours, not days. 2) don't create a path that explodes egress/quota billing. 3) raw copies must live encrypted and only rehydrated on-demand.

ops-bot: incident-bot note: previous canary generated unredacted_dump for incident-1743 on 2259991111 — access recorded at 2025-10-02T14:32Z (audit id: A-2025-1743)

elaine_privacy: From privacy/legal POV: we need a consent matrix. Customer-admin approval ok for customer data. For end-user personal data, require customer opt-in or a legal exception. Request UI must record who requested, why, approver, and TTL. Hash identifiers in metrics.

julien_ml: For model telemetry (embeddings/kv), we already pseudonymize inputs. For full traces I propose storing an HMAC of the raw input (keyed) so we can correlate without storing PII. When raw is needed, we decrypt only the specific trace.

maya_ux: UX suggestion: Console -> Request history shows a 'View raw (restricted)' button. If user clicks, open modal: 1) show required approvals, 2) collect reason + ticket link, 3) TTL selector (1h/4h/24h), 4) disclosure text: 'Access will be audited and visible to legal.' Button disabled until request is complete.

kevin_p: Implementation sketch for route config:```yaml
inspect:
  enabled: true
  retention_hours: 72   # raw retention after session close
  require_approval: true
  approver_roles: ["legal","sre"]
  redact_default: true
  sampled_raw_percent: 0.1
  allow_unredacted_routes: ["debug-canary","internal-inspect"]
```We'd expose POST /v1/inspect-sessions and GET /v1/audit/{id}.

maria: Two more asks: (a) sampling defaults — for high-volume routes sample raw at 0.1% and keep scrubbed logs for metrics; (b) support emergency breakglass where SRE can request immediate access but it must create a retrospective ticket and trigger automated alerts to legal.

samg: Edge cases: background batch jobs and sys-internal traffic should default to scrubbed-only. Also ensure KV cache never stores raw inputs: the cache key should be HMAC-only.

elaine_privacy: Audit trail schema must include requester id, approver id, ticket id, TTL, reason, KMS-key-id, and a hash of the unredacted payload. We should also emit an Alert to compliance on any breakglass access.

julien_ml: Performance note: decrypting on-demand adds latency. Prefer spawning ephemeral workers in private subnet to decrypt and serve raw traces to the web session, then shred memory. Benchmarking required.

maya_ux: Microcopy for modal: 'Request access to raw request/response data for debugging. Access is time-limited, logged, and requires approval. Misuse may result in revoked access.' Can mock up quick prototype Friday.

kevin_p: I'll draft an RFC with route-level config, API, and quota rules. Proposed quotas: max 5 concurrent sessions per org, session TTL max 24h, requests rate-limited to avoid DOS. Also add console toggle for canary orgs.

maria: Next steps: Kevin draft RFC, Julien run perf on decrypt path, Elaine/Legal to sign off approval matrix, Maya prototype UI. Follow-up in #platform-sync on Friday morning.

ops-bot: deploy-bot created ticket INF-5429 for inspect-session RFC :white_check_mark:

kevin_p: thanks all — will post RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — moving to action items. :rocket:
